title: Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: Platform Workers Bill protections
sections.summary: Parliament passed the Platform Workers Bill to strengthen protections for platform workers in housing, retirement, work injury and representation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To recap, Parliament passed the Platform Workers Bill to strengthen protections for platform workers providing platform services, such as ride hail and delivery services, in the areas of housing and retirement adequacy, financial protection in the case of work injury and representation.

sections.label: Second Reading vote result
sections.summary: The Second Reading of the Bill was carried with 82 Ayes, no Noes and no Abstentions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I will proceed to declare the voting results now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: The Second Reading of the Bill has been carried by the votes of not less than two-thirds of the total number of Elected and Non-Constituency Members of Parliament.      .
